rationale: Introduces a new concurrent encoder package (~20 files, all additive) with complex FFmpeg orchestration, caching, and keyframe alignment; all edits are independently revertible and open questions are implementation details within the scoped architecture.

signals.blast_radius: Eight new core modules in encoder-ffmpeg package plus tools/bench; integration in changes 006/007 is additive (new function calls)
signals.unresolved: Six open questions about bitrate tuning, chunked vs single-pipe default, pool sizing, memory ceiling, cache location, and Linux support; all are implementation choices within the committed concurrent architecture
signals.irreversibility: New package is git-revertible; no data migration, capability removal, or integration refactoring required
